title: RTO/RPO Concepts
summary: Recovery time and data loss objectives shape backup/HA design.
explain: Recovery time and data loss objectives shape backup/HA design. In Odyssey simulations this is modeled at Tier 1–2 fidelity with explicit labels — verify production details in official SAP documentation.
analogy: Practical memory hook: associate "RTO/RPO Concepts" with a concrete failure mode you have seen or will simulate in a mission.
whyItMatters: If you cannot explain RTO/RPO Concepts in one minute, you will mis-diagnose related incidents.
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “RTO/RPO Concepts” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (RTO/RPO → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Landing zone setup week: apply RTO/RPO Concepts so Dev/Test/Prod don't share blast radius.
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “RTO/RPO Concepts” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “RTO/RPO Concepts”.
